benchmark_results.splitMethod: Lineage-aware 80/20 held-out split (NCBI Pathogen Detection isolates)
benchmark_results.limitations: ESBL detection (blaCTX-M) shows high concordance; rare promoter mutations in chromosomal ampC may cause minor discordances.
Carbapenemase genes (NDM, OXA-48-like, KPC) confer decisive resistance. Low-level resistance due to porin loss + ESBL may not be captured by single gene rules.
Aminoglycoside modifying enzymes (aac(3), ant(2'')) correlate well; substrate specificity must be strictly matched.
tet(A), tet(B) efflux pumps account for majority of resistance. Occasional expression variability observed.
Intrinsic oqxA/B efflux confers baseline reduced susceptibility; high-level resistance requires gyrA S83I/L or parC mutations.
Intrinsic SHV beta-lactamase confers ampicillin resistance but requires ESBL mutation or acquired CTX-M for ceftriaxone resistance.
High positive predictive value for carbapenemase genes (NDM, OXA-48, KPC).
ArmA 16S rRNA methyltransferase confers pan-aminoglycoside resistance.
mecA and mecC are surrogate markers for methicillin (cefoxitin) resistance. Exceptional sensitivity and specificity.
vanA/vanB operons confer high-level resistance. VISA (intermediate resistance via cell-wall thickening mutations) is not assessable by AMRFinderPlus.
ermA/C ribosomal methylation and msrA efflux pumps. Inducible resistance requires D-test AST verification.
grlA (parC homolog) and gyrA point mutations. Efflux via norA may cause low-level resistance without QRDR point mutations.

demo_datasets.label: KP-2024-C01 (Concordant K. pneumoniae)
demo_datasets.description: Concordant carbapenem-resistant K. pneumoniae isolate carrying blaNDM-1, blaCTX-M-15, and oqxA/B. Genomic resistance findings match laboratory AST results across all tested beta-lactams and fluoroquinolones.

demo_datasets.label: EC-2024-D02 (Discordant E. coli Cipro S / gyrA+)
demo_datasets.description: Signature discordance case: E. coli displaying phenotypic Ciprofloxacin susceptibility (AST: S, MIC: 0.12 mg/L) despite genomic identification of fluoroquinolone resistance mutations gyrA S83L and parC S80I. Triggers GENOMIC_RESISTANT_AST_SUSCEPTIBLE review flag.

demo_datasets.label: SA-2024-SYN03 (Synthetic S. aureus Control)
demo_datasets.description: Synthetic MRSA assembly carrying mecA and ermA. Demonstrates high-reliability Cefoxitin resistance and Erythromycin resistance interpretation.

High-priority discordance: Curated genomic resistance markers were detected (RESISTANCE_EVIDENCE_STRONG), yet phenotypic AST indicates Susceptible. Potential causes include subpopulation heteroresistance, unexpressed or silenced genes, incorrect isolate identification, or AST inoculum artifacts. Laboratory review recommended.
